comparisons.peer_summary: AMD focuses its R&D on designing next-generation CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs, Adaptive SoCs, accelerators, SOMs, and SmartNICs, along with associated software and hardware design tools.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose detailed focus areas for their integrated circuit design investments. Qualcomm highlights investments in 'integrated circuit customers with chipsets designed on leading-edge technology nodes' for mobile, automotive, and IoT, whereas AMD focuses its R&D on 'delivering the next generation of processors (CPU and GPU), FPGAs and Adaptive SoCs, accelerators... and associated software.' Both disclosures emphasize the convergence of hardware design with specific software environments (Qualcomm supports Android/Linux; AMD focuses on optimized software tools and libraries), indicating a similar strategic approach to bundling advanced silicon with software ecosystems to drive product leadership.

sentences.text: We make investments to provide our integrated circuit customers with chipsets designed on leading-edge technology nodes that combine multiple technologies for use in mobile devices; automotive systems for connectivity, digital cockpit and ADAS/AD; and IoT including consumer electronic devices, industrial devices and edge networking products.
We support Android, Windows, Linux and other client software environments in our chipsets.

Our main area of focus is on delivering the next generation of processors (CPU and GPU), FPGAs and Adaptive SoCs, accelerators (adaptive, graphics and DPU), SOMs and SmartNICs and associated software.

We also focus on software as part of the development of our products, including design automation tools for hardware, embedded software, optimized software tools and libraries that extend the reach of our platforms to software and AI developers.

comparisons.peer_topic: R&D investment strategy and competitive advantage
comparisons.peer_summary: Broadcom commits to continuous investment in product development and enhancement, leveraging proprietary R&D to gain competitive advantages through performance differentiation. The company also opportunistically seeks to enhance capabilities through the acquisition of engineers and technologies, while maintaining significant R&D spending to preserve its competitive position.
comparisons.comparison: Both Qualcomm and Broadcom explicitly mention using acquisitions and transactions to enhance their technology capabilities and support new products. Qualcomm states it engages in acquisitions to 'meet certain technology needs' and 'support the design and introduction of new products,' while Broadcom notes it 'opportunistically seeks to enhance its capabilities through the acquisition of engineers with complementary research and development skills and complementary technologies.' Both firms treat M&A as a strategic complement to their internal R&D efforts to maintain competitive advantages.

comparisons.peer_topic: Automotive Platform Solutions and DRIVE Hyperion Brand
comparisons.peer_summary: The company delivers a complete end-to-end automated driving and in-vehicle cockpit computing solution for the AV market under the DRIVE Hyperion brand, leveraging AI technology leadership and long-standing automotive relationships. The DRIVE Hyperion platform includes high-performance hardware, a reference sensor set, and an open, modular software platform for autonomous driving and intelligent in-vehicle experiences.
comparisons.comparison: Both Qualcomm and NVIDIA disclose specific strategic investments and product focuses within the automotive sector. Qualcomm mentions investments in 'automotive systems for connectivity, digital cockpit and ADAS/AD,' while NVIDIA describes delivering a 'complete end-to-end automated driving and in-vehicle cockpit computing solution... under the DRIVE Hyperion brand.' Both companies are aligning their R&D and product strategies toward autonomous driving and advanced cockpit computing, leveraging their respective strengths (Qualcomm in connectivity/chipsets, NVIDIA in AI/computing platforms) to serve the same high-growth automotive application area.
